range_boundaries.rule: Until the relevant small/mid-Dow horizontal levels are broken to the upside, treat H1 as range / not yet returned to rising direction.

rising_resume_trigger.name: RED_CIRCLE_STRUCTURAL_HIGH_BREAK
rising_resume_trigger.meaning: H1 rising direction is considered resumed only after price exceeds the user-marked red-circle structural high.

tl_before_resume.rule: The cyan TL may be drawn before the red-circle breakout, but it is provisional and not yet an important line.

tl_after_resume.rule: After the red-circle structural high is exceeded, the previously drawable cyan TL becomes structurally important.

large_dow_tl_confirmation.rule: Only after rising has resumed and a second valid low reacts at the mid-Dow upper horizontal level is the large-Dow TL confirmed as a full current line.

forbidden_shortcuts: Do not infer H1 rising direction merely because mechanical Large/Mid candidate directions are RISING.
Do not promote a drawable TL to an important/current line before the structural-high breakout.
Do not treat a local FALLING active leg as an automatic H1 downtrend while this range-resolution sequence is unresolved.
Do not require deletion of contextual/reference lines solely because a new candidate exists.

research_interpretation.supersedes_prior_b02_03_simplification: For this case, the user does not label pre-break H1 as already rising; the pre-break state is range/not-yet-rising despite mechanical Large/Mid=RISING.
